qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md (esp. 'A negative needs a successful control')
qc/runs/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r1/raw-evidence-index.json (scope: scripted golden observations only; no weak/mutant-app or configured judge runs)
evidence:
Strengths: both gates carry explicit positive controls (render judge.toml:23 wrong password refused THEN correct password signs in, prompt.md:9 'A valid sign-in immediately after the invalid attempt is the required positive control'; constraints judge.toml:23 requires a successful create + independent-context readback). All three scored prompts zero a blank/static app via the creation+Observer readback gate (functional prompt.md:11-13, polish prompt.md:11-12, visual prompt.md:11-12), so a totally dead app cannot earn any row. Functional prompt.md:13 adds a blanket rule: 'Every refusal row needs its own positive control: a successful action of the same kind, observed in this review.' Many functional rows pair explicitly in-criterion: hro_job_open:29, hro_add_email_rules:47, hro_move_one_stage:56, hro_reject_reason:83, hro_reject_hired:92, hro_reopen:101, hro_undo_full:128, hro_mgr_early_refused:155, hro_anonymous:191, hro_stale_refused:200, hro_bulk_places:227, hro_undo_conflict:245, hro_activity_refusals:272, hro_notes:281, hro_msg_compose:308; polish hro_pol_live_board:23 ('If no update arrives within 15 seconds ... this row is 0'), hro_pol_failed_send:50, hro_pol_session_resume:59 ('which is the positive control').

Defects (paired control missing inside the criterion, per quality-checks.md #30 'paired inside the same criterion' and REVIEW_POLICY 'A dead feature must not earn credit for doing nothing'):
(1) polish/judge.toml:32 hro_pol_live_thread (weight 3 of 12 polish = 0.05 reward): 'When it appears (within 15 seconds, no reload) the reply still reads exactly what was typed, the box still has focus ... Fails if the draft or focus is lost or the view moves away from the newest message.' No clause makes non-arrival a 0, unlike its sibling hro_pol_live_board:23 which explicitly does. The polish prompt has no blanket positive-control rule like functional prompt.md:13. A conversation with no live delivery trivially preserves draft, focus and position.
(2) functional/judge.toml:389 hro_candidate_private (weight 2.5): 'no response a candidate page receives contains internal notes ... the replayed staff notes or card-detail read is refused; asking for another application's conversation is answered as not found.' Every leg is an absence/refusal; the matching success (candidate's own applications and own conversation load by the same kind of request) lives only in sibling hro_candidate_view:380. A candidate side that returns nothing / 404s everything passes all legs. Policy: 'Reuse an observed fact, not another row's pass flag.' The global prompt.md:13 rule addresses 'refusal rows' but not the 'no response contains' absence leg.
(3) Rows relying solely on the blanket prompt.md:13 rule with no in-criterion control: hro_interview_full:110 (fail clause only 'Interview can hold more cards than places'; an app enforcing places-1 never exceeds and still refuses E), hro_undo_once:254 ('no undo is offered' is satisfied by an app with no undo), hro_bulk_all_or_none:218 (an app whose bulk move always refuses passes), hro_mgr_other_job:164, hro_observer_readonly:173, hro_candidate_no_staff:182 (refusal of moves/notes/adds with no named control that the same request succeeds for an authorised user). The blanket rule mitigates these (lower risk), but they are not paired inside the criterion as the skill reference requires and depend on the judge applying a prompt-level sentence.

Runtime: raw-evidence-index.json states 'reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'; no weak-app run measured whether a judge awards these rows to a dead-feature app, so the counterexamples are unrefuted source analysis (NOT EXERCISED). Visual (Likert craft) has no negative legs: N-A for this row.
counterexample: Broken app A: staff board, jobs, candidates and messaging work (all gates pass), but conversations have no live delivery (no polling/push). In polish, Noor's message never appears on Rafael's page; the typed reply, focus and newest-message view are trivially unchanged, so a judge reading hro_pol_live_thread literally ('Fails if the draft or focus is lost or the view moves away') awards 1 (0.05 total reward) for a feature that never ran. Broken app B: same working staff side, but every candidate API call returns 404/empty (candidate sees 'No applications'). hro_candidate_private: no response contains notes/reasons/others (nothing is returned), the replayed staff notes read is refused, another application's conversation is 'not found' -> 2.5/58.5 functional weight earned while the candidate side is dead. Broken app C: no undo implemented -> hro_undo_once 'no undo is offered for it again' and 'no longer undoable' hold vacuously unless the judge applies the prompt-level rule.
suggested_fix: Add an in-criterion control to each negative row: hro_pol_live_thread 'If Noor's message does not appear within 15 seconds, preservation cannot be shown and this row is 0'; hro_candidate_private 'the same candidate's own applications and own conversation load with their messages through the same page (the control); a candidate page that receives none of its own data is 0'; and name the observed success for hro_interview_full (two cards entered Interview), hro_undo_once (a successful undo), hro_bulk_all_or_none (a successful multi-card move), hro_mgr_other_job (the job's own manager's move), hro_observer_readonly/hro_candidate_no_staff (Rafael's same move/add/note requests succeeded).
